big: A PMS brochure shows 22% a year. The client's own statement shows far less. The gap? Fees, brokerage, custody, taxes and timing. Reading the fine print is the real skill.

lines: It is the return the manager must beat before earning a performance fee. A high-water mark means the fee applies only to gains above the previous peak. Both protect the client.

note: Plus any fixed fee, brokerage, custody and taxes. Figures are made up.
